title: Migrate failing unit tests to integration tests
body: These unit tests are failing because they try to run `/proc/self/exe` which doesn't work when running as a unit tests. These tests would be better migrated to an integration test maybe using docker compose.

title: Enable cluster mode
body:
It would be neat to enable the system to be run as a cluster. Clients could then submit jobs to the cluster without needing to know which machine was actually running their job.

There are obviously some complex issues here:
* how do requests get routed to worker nodes? If a job is running on one host a status request for that job also needs to go to that host.
* do we need load-balancing?

title: Add rate limiting
body: It would be neat to add rate limiting to the system. Probably on a per-user basis and probably only for submitting jobs.

title: Cicd setup
body:
This is a first pass of adding automated builds. I've disabled testing for now since it requires Docker to run in `--privileged` mode which is unsupported by Github actions.

I can probably refactor the tests into unit and integration tests so at least the unit tests can run.

title: Use a separate Alpine filesystem for each job
body: Currently each submitted job shares the same Alpine filesystem which means that processes can interfere. A better approach would be to clone the filesystem for each new job.

title: Update readme to include example usage of client
body: The readme is pretty sparse. Make it friendlier by including a worked example of using the client.

title: Update design document to include approach to resource constraints
body: The design document doesn't mention anything about limiting the resources of submitted processes. Include details of this in the design doc.

title: Update design document to include isolation approach
body: The design doc doesn't mention anything about isolating processes. Update it to include the approach I've taken.

title: Setup CI/CD
body: It would be good to use Github actions (or any other appropriate tool) to have a CI/CD pipeline for the project.

title: Implement resource constraints with cgroups
body: I want to limit the resources used by submitted processes. The best way to do this would be using Linux cgroups.
